purpose: Canonical inventory of asserted Imp claims and telos targets. This file declares scope and proof obligations; current evidence state is computed by the dashboard and is never stored here.

claim_state_vocabulary.asserted: A claim intended for the named product profile; it is publishable only when its computed evidence state is proven.
claim_state_vocabulary.target: A declared telos target that is not a current product capability.
claim_state_vocabulary.retired: A deliberately withdrawn claim retained only for audit history.

gate_policy_vocabulary.blocking: Missing proof blocks readiness of the claim's profile.
gate_policy_vocabulary.informational: The claim remains visible but does not contribute to profile readiness.

evidence_rung_vocabulary.C0: The API exists and is callable.
evidence_rung_vocabulary.C1: Behavior conforms to a pinned authority for the declared scope.
evidence_rung_vocabulary.C2: The capability executes operationally through its real boundary.
evidence_rung_vocabulary.C3: Held-out evidence supports effectiveness for the declared task portfolio.
evidence_rung_vocabulary.C4: An exact paper protocol is reproduced from public authoritative materials.
evidence_rung_vocabulary.C5: Powered paired evidence supports comparative advantage or superiority.

claims.scope: Clean package consumption and the documented v0.1 public API paths covered by package contract tests.
claims.statement: Imp passes the clean-room package contract for the documented v0.1 public API paths exercised outside the source checkout.

requirements.threshold: fresh clean-room package consumer proof passes

claims.scope: Executable shipped documentation plus a current provider smoke.
claims.statement: Imp docs and Livebooks are executable product evidence, including real-provider proof cells for provider-relevant features.

requirements.threshold: all shipped Livebooks execute successfully
LIVE_PROVIDER=1 mix live.check passes

claims.scope: The pinned normalized golden-trace cases and named Imp semantic checks; excludes byte-identical Python prompt templates and unlisted upstream behavior.
claims.statement: Imp passes the pinned golden-trace cases for signatures, Predict, ChainOfThought, typed adapters, and ReAct tool traces, plus named semantic checks for streaming, save/load redaction, and cache behavior.

requirements.threshold: all golden trace parity cases and Imp semantic checks pass

claims.scope: Telos research comparison on the named live benchmark tasks under current_low_cost, frontier_sanity, and historical_research policy; excludes the v0.1 provider runtime contract and blanket all-task parity.
limitations: Requires fresh complete matched-model campaigns.
claims.statement: The telos research target is a matched-model effectiveness comparison between Imp and Python DSPy on the named live benchmark tasks with current prompt contracts, complete instrumentation, runtime-shape evidence, and consistent execution settings.

requirements.threshold: required current_low_cost, frontier_sanity, and historical_research lanes satisfy their policies

claims.scope: BootstrapFewShot compilation semantics against a pinned DSPy authority; excludes optimizer lift and provider effectiveness.
limitations: Deterministic Imp tests do not by themselves establish pinned cross-runtime conformance.
claims.statement: The open target is a source-bound BootstrapFewShot differential covering teacher preparation, trace acceptance, demo limits, error handling, and compiled-program assembly.

requirements.threshold: a source-bound family-specific BootstrapFewShot semantic differential passes

claims.scope: RandomSearch candidate generation, evaluation, selection, and reporting semantics against a pinned DSPy authority; excludes optimizer lift.
limitations: Exact Python RNG sequence parity is not implied unless a family artifact explicitly proves it.
claims.statement: The open target is a source-bound family-specific RandomSearch semantic differential with deviations stated explicitly.

requirements.threshold: a source-bound family-specific RandomSearch semantic differential passes

claims.scope: The five deterministic COPRO observations in the canonical source-bound DSPy 3.2.1 isolation artifact.
limitations: The artifact explicitly excludes exact Python RNG parity, provider behavior, effectiveness, and full optimizer parity.
claims.statement: Imp has source-bound C1 evidence for the five declared COPRO isolation observations against authenticated DSPy 3.2.1 source.

requirements.threshold: the canonical COPRO isolation artifact verifies all five declared observations and retained exclusions

claims.scope: Held-out BootstrapFewShot lift under matched rows, budgets, models, and seeds.
limitations: Semantic conformance, when available, does not establish held-out lift.
claims.statement: The open target is independently scored multi-seed BootstrapFewShot held-out effectiveness under matched controls.

requirements.threshold: family-specific held-out BootstrapFewShot lift satisfies the preregistered multi-seed policy

claims.scope: Held-out RandomSearch lift under matched rows, budgets, models, and seeds.
limitations: Candidate scheduling behavior does not establish generalization.
claims.statement: The open target is independently scored multi-seed RandomSearch held-out effectiveness under matched controls.

requirements.threshold: family-specific held-out RandomSearch lift satisfies the preregistered multi-seed policy

claims.scope: Held-out COPRO lift under matched rows, budgets, models, and seeds.
limitations: The admitted C1 isolation artifact explicitly provides no effectiveness evidence.
claims.statement: The open target is independently scored multi-seed COPRO held-out effectiveness under matched controls.

requirements.threshold: family-specific held-out COPRO lift satisfies the preregistered multi-seed policy

claims.scope: Held-out Ensemble selection and composition effectiveness under matched controls.
limitations: Implemented composition semantics do not establish quality lift.
claims.statement: The open target is family-specific Ensemble effectiveness, not a generalized optimizer claim.

requirements.threshold: family-specific held-out Ensemble effectiveness satisfies the preregistered policy

claims.scope: Held-out Avatar and AvatarOptimizer trajectory-rewrite effectiveness under matched controls.
limitations: Typed actions and deterministic trajectory tests establish mechanics only.
claims.statement: The open target is family-specific Avatar effectiveness with independently scored held-out trajectories.

requirements.threshold: family-specific held-out Avatar effectiveness satisfies the preregistered policy

claims.scope: Provider-backed BootstrapFinetune effectiveness under a matched training and held-out evaluation protocol.
limitations: The admitted local MLX lifecycle claim is separate and does not establish paid-provider BootstrapFinetune effectiveness.
claims.statement: The open target is family-specific provider-backed BootstrapFinetune effectiveness; no paid-provider effectiveness is currently claimed.

requirements.threshold: a bounded provider-backed BootstrapFinetune campaign demonstrates held-out effectiveness under matched controls

claims.scope: Held-out BetterTogether composition effectiveness for declared prompt/weight stage sequences.
limitations: Lifecycle and prefix-selection tests do not prove provider completion or matched effectiveness.
claims.statement: The open target is family-specific BetterTogether effectiveness; the local MLX result is not generalized into this claim.

requirements.threshold: family-specific BetterTogether held-out effectiveness satisfies the preregistered prompt/weight composition policy

claims.scope: Held-out mmGRPO/GRPO weight-optimization effectiveness under a pinned training protocol.
limitations: Provider job lifecycle support does not establish GRPO training effectiveness.
claims.statement: The open target is family-specific mmGRPO effectiveness; no provider-backed GRPO effectiveness is currently claimed.

requirements.threshold: a pinned mmGRPO campaign demonstrates independently scored held-out effectiveness under matched controls

claims.scope: Telos research replication across the six named GEPA paper families; excludes a claim for unlisted datasets or optimizer families.
limitations: Papillon and HoVer full-scope artifacts are incomplete.
claims.statement: The telos research target is a six-family GEPA replication artifact comparing baseline, DSPy GEPA, Imp GEPA, and MIPROv2 with cost, budget, seed, and split-gap metadata; SIMBA may be reported as extra comparator evidence when present.

requirements.threshold: gepa-replication artifact covers AIMEBench, HotpotQABench, hoverBench, IFBench, LiveBenchMathBench, and Papillon with required optimizer, budget, cost, seed, and split-gap fields

claims.scope: Provider-backed reflective optimization of executable non-prompt text artifacts.
limitations: The bounded 2026-07-16 provider campaign failed the first code-artifact effectiveness policy, produced no admissible artifact, and was stopped after $0.057845 of successful Anthropic usage; runtime mechanics and older smoke artifacts cannot substitute for this claim.
The target is scoped to Imp-native effectiveness and does not claim paper-scale or matched-internals parity with upstream Optimize Anything.
claims.statement: The open target is evidence that Imp Optimize Anything improves measurable non-prompt artifacts across multiple seeds using executable held-out evaluators, with provider cost and checkpoint provenance; current evidence does not establish that result.

requirements.threshold: all three non-prompt classes show positive mean lift and a majority of improving runs across at least three live provider-backed seeds

claims.scope: Exact or construct-valid comparison of Imp and upstream Optimize Anything across the released paper portfolio under matched proposal and evaluation budgets.
limitations: The v0.1 Imp-native campaign has no admitted effectiveness artifact, and no paper-scale upstream comparison is complete.
claims.statement: The open telos target is a matched upstream comparison across heterogeneous non-prompt artifact domains; neither runtime mechanics nor an Imp-only smoke can satisfy it.

requirements.threshold: a matched multi-domain upstream comparison satisfies the preregistered paper-portfolio policy

claims.scope: The source-bound provider-free memory-retrieval row shared with DSPy plus Imp-native two-hop retrieval and injected HTTP retriever protocol-shape rows.
limitations: This fixture contract does not establish HotPotQA answer quality, broad retrieval quality, a public HTTP service, or live provider behavior.
claims.statement: Imp passes the named deterministic RAG retrieval and retriever-protocol fixture contracts.

requirements.threshold: the exact rag_memory_retrieval, rag_multi_hop_retrieval, and http_retriever_protocol_shape rows pass in a source-bound provider-free artifact

claims.scope: The exact provider-free lookup-tool trajectory shared with DSPy and the Imp unknown-tool terminal trace.
limitations: Queued actions are fixed; this does not establish model-selected tool-use quality, BFCL performance, or live provider behavior.
claims.statement: Imp passes the named deterministic ReAct lookup and unknown-tool trace contracts.

requirements.threshold: the exact react_lookup_tool and react_unknown_tool_error_trace rows pass in a source-bound provider-free artifact

claims.scope: One Imp-native deterministic trajectory that records failing, unknown, and malformed calls before a bounded successful submit.
limitations: This is an Imp-native scripted recovery contract, not a DSPy comparison or evidence of model-selected recovery effectiveness.
claims.statement: Imp ReActV2 preserves the named error observations and reaches the declared submit terminal in the bounded fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact react_v2_recovers_from_tool_and_submit_errors row passes and terminates by submit

claims.scope: One provider-free in-process MCP catalog import executed through an Imp agent with an exact tool and agent trace.
limitations: This row does not exercise a public MCP endpoint, stdio process, Streamable HTTP session, or external network recovery.
claims.statement: Imp passes the named in-process MCP import and agent trace fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact mcp_import_agent_trace row passes in a source-bound provider-free artifact

claims.scope: One Imp-native deterministic agent policy denial with exact tool_denied and agent_error trace events.
limitations: This fixture does not establish child-agent effectiveness, autonomous planning quality, or provider-backed behavior.
claims.statement: Imp records the declared denial events for the named bounded agent policy fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact agent_tool_policy_denial row passes with the declared denial trace

claims.scope: One Imp-native provider-free CodeAct fixture that executes a typed tool then a BEAM-safe sandbox expression.
limitations: No Python code execution, DSPy comparison, model-selected program quality, or live provider behavior is claimed.
claims.statement: Imp CodeAct passes the named typed-tool and BEAM-safe expression fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact code_act_tool_program row passes with the declared two-step trace

claims.scope: Two Imp-native provider-free ProgramOfThought fixtures: a safe arithmetic expression and rejection of an unsafe remote command AST.
limitations: No Python execution parity, generated-program effectiveness, or live provider behavior is claimed.
claims.statement: Imp ProgramOfThought evaluates the named safe expression and rejects the named unsafe AST fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact program_of_thought_safe_eval and program_of_thought_rejects_unsafe_remote_call rows pass

claims.scope: One Imp-native provider-free incremental field parsing fixture with exact answer and rationale events.
limitations: This row does not establish provider streaming transport parity, throughput, or partial-stream recovery.
claims.statement: Imp emits the declared incremental field events for the named deterministic streaming fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact streaming_incremental_fields row passes with the declared events

claims.scope: One Imp-native provider-free Task stream fixture with three exact ordered successful results.
limitations: This row does not establish throughput, all concurrency modes, cancellation, or provider-backed asynchronous behavior.
claims.statement: Imp preserves the declared ordered results for the named deterministic asynchronous stream fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact tasks_async_stream_ordered_results row passes with the declared ordered results

claims.scope: One provider-free save/load fixture proving that its dummy provider secret is absent from the persisted representation.
limitations: This single fixture does not substitute for the broader hostile redaction audit or establish compatibility for every serializable program graph.
claims.statement: Imp omits the dummy provider secret from the named deterministic save/load fixture.

requirements.threshold: the exact save_load_redacts_provider_secret row passes without persisting its dummy secret

claims.scope: The pinned ten-row provider-free HotPotQA retrieval and supporting-fact differential only.
limitations: The bounded fixture does not establish answer-generation quality, broad HotPotQA generalization, or paper-scale effectiveness.
claims.statement: Imp passes the declared pinned provider-free HotPotQA retrieval differential for the ten fixture rows.

requirements.threshold: the source-bound ten-row HotPotQA retrieval differential passes exact retrieval and supporting-fact checks

claims.scope: Held-out retrieval-grounded HotPotQA answer and supporting-fact quality under matched controls.
limitations: The current ten-row provider-free differential is C1 fixture evidence and cannot satisfy this target.
claims.statement: The open target is non-inferior held-out HotPotQA retrieval-grounded quality under preregistered matched models, corpus, calls, and scoring.

requirements.threshold: held-out HotPotQA answer and supporting-fact quality satisfy the preregistered matched comparison

claims.scope: Cross-language agreement on twelve original CC0 BFCL-shaped positive fixtures and nine preregistered mutations.
limitations: No official BFCL or DSPy scorer code or rows are executed; this is T1 adapted-scorer conformance only.
claims.statement: Imp and the independent Python reference agree on the declared BFCL-shaped scorer fixtures and mutations.

requirements.threshold: all twelve positive fixtures and nine mutations agree across the Elixir and independent Python scorers

claims.scope: Model-produced tool-name, ordered-call, argument, and terminal accuracy on a pinned BFCL evaluation protocol.
limitations: Adapted scorer agreement does not measure model generation, tool selection, or official leaderboard performance.
claims.statement: The open target is independently scored BFCL tool-selection effectiveness from model-produced calls under matched controls.

requirements.threshold: a pinned BFCL protocol scores model-produced tool calls and satisfies the preregistered matched policy

claims.scope: Six shared queued-action scenarios executed through actual Imp and source-authenticated DSPy 3.2.1 ReAct runtimes.
limitations: Fixture tools own retry/idempotency, actions are held constant, and timeout is injected; this does not establish model-selected recovery or wall-clock timeout parity.
claims.statement: Imp matches the declared exact runtime observations and terminals for the six bounded failure-injected scenarios.

requirements.threshold: all six source-authenticated queued-action scenarios match exact observations and terminals

claims.scope: Model-selected recovery and terminal task completion under an identical matched cross-runtime failure schedule.
limitations: The C2 queued-action differential and local injected transport rows do not establish model recovery effectiveness.
claims.statement: The open target is matched model-selected recovery effectiveness with preregistered faults, budgets, terminals, and task scoring.

requirements.threshold: an identical model-selected matched failure schedule satisfies preregistered recovery and task-completion thresholds

claims.scope: Telos research comparison for paper-scale RLM long-context effectiveness across the five named paper families; excludes the v0.1 RLM runtime and contract claim.
limitations: The exact paper-authoritative S-NIAH instances, BrowseComp+ query/document selection, and OOLONG-Pairs scorer are unavailable; the checked-in manifest retains explicit ACQUIRE_AND_PIN_SHA256 or ACQUIRE_AND_FREEZE_IDS markers for unavailable authorities.
The deterministic RLM fixture lane is T0 contract replay, and current T1 or sampled T2 evidence cannot substitute for exact paper-scale authority or prove effectiveness and long-context parity.
claims.statement: The telos research target is a complete paper-scale RLM reproduction with exact paper authority, rather than scripted fixture replay or an operational sample.

requirements.threshold: RLM artifact is T3 paper-scale evidence with a complete paper protocol

claims.scope: Pinned deterministic SemanticF1 and CompleteAndGrounded normalization and aggregation semantics against authenticated DSPy source.
limitations: The admitted T1 artifact does not establish natural judge calibration, task quality, or refinement effectiveness; a dedicated claim-dashboard lane remains to be wired before this claim can be promoted.
claims.statement: The open publication target is source-bound T1 auto-evaluation semantic conformance, kept separate from judge and refinement quality.

requirements.threshold: a dedicated source-bound claim lane validates the admitted T1 auto-evaluation artifact against current committed source

claims.scope: Natural-task SemanticF1 and completeness/groundedness judge calibration against independent held-out labels.
limitations: Deterministic score-normalization agreement does not show that model judgments are calibrated or useful.
claims.statement: The open target is natural judge quality measured against independent held-out labels with bias and calibration reported.

requirements.threshold: a preregistered natural-task campaign establishes judge agreement, calibration, and bias against independent labels

claims.scope: Held-out quality improvement from Refine advice and Best-of-N selection under equal call budgets and independent executable scoring.
limitations: Control-flow and feedback plumbing tests do not establish advice quality or net held-out lift.
claims.statement: The open target is independently scored held-out improvement from Refine advice and Best-of-N under matched budgets.

requirements.threshold: a preregistered natural-task campaign shows independent held-out lift under equal candidate and advice-call budgets

claims.scope: Informational regression guard for named provider-free local paths; excludes end-to-end latency, parity, and speed claims.
limitations: Named absolute and reference-relative budgets are regression alarms and provide no evidence that Imp matches or outperforms DSPy; ratios are measurements only.
claims.statement: Imp records provider-free local-overhead regression guards with named per-operation budgets, rationale, and environment identity without presenting any budget or ratio as a speed claim.

requirements.threshold: all paired provider-free paths remain below their named absolute and reference-relative budgets in a clean current-source artifact

claims.scope: Pinned local MLX LoRA training, official fused deployment, and portable-program rebinding on the canonical Banking77 holdout.
limitations: Does not establish paid-provider, BetterTogether, GRPO, or DSPy-matched training parity.
claims.statement: Imp can execute a fresh Elixir-owned local MLX training lifecycle whose officially fused model improves the pinned held-out task and whose credential-free saved program reproduces the fused outputs after explicit runtime rebinding.

requirements.threshold: independently validated clean campaign shows positive held-out accuracy and macro-F1 lift plus exact fused/save-load equivalence

claims.scope: Provider-compatible local protocol boundaries; excludes paid training completion.
claims.statement: Imp production protocol boundaries for provider training, retrievers, and MCP are exercised through source-checkout protocol gates before being claimed as production surface.

requirements.threshold: mix protocol.check passes

claims.scope: Provider-free repeated failure and recovery behavior with verified runtime leak accounting.
claims.statement: Imp deterministic cancellation, timeout, bounded concurrency, partial-stream failure, retry/idempotency, and optimizer resume recovery paths pass the canonical T0 campaign without runtime leaks.

requirements.threshold: verified current-schema artifact independently recomputes all deterministic cases and zero runtime leaks

claims.scope: Telos local operational recovery evidence for exactly two rows: provider-shaped timeout/retry/idempotency and integration retrieval plus exact tool-agent failure/retry/submit recovery.
limitations: The operational rows use local injected transports, a static LM, and dummy canaries; they do not establish external-provider behavior.
No live provider training job was created or cancelled; training recovery remains deterministic-only.

The authority is limited to one bounded injected timeout followed by idempotent success, one closed retriever transport followed by retrieval success, and one exact tool failure/retry/submit trajectory.
claims.statement: The telos research target is completed local operational evidence for the provider_retry_timeout_idempotency_live and retrieval_and_tool_agent_recovery_live compatibility rows; it does not claim external providers, live provider training, public MCP service recovery, or exhaustive network failure coverage.

requirements.threshold: verified deterministic T0 authority plus a valid completed provider_retry_timeout_idempotency_live row
verified deterministic T0 authority plus a valid completed retrieval_and_tool_agent_recovery_live row
